name: photo-tags
description: Problem section: centred heading over a photo with problem tags pinned around it, then a panda call-to-action bar. Live: .sp-prob on the September 2026 solution pages.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

photo_width.description: Photo box width in px (live: 547). The 2026 hub frames use a 602 x 260 two-photo composite.

art_height.description: Height of the art stage that holds the photo and the tags, in px (live: 364).

tags.description: Up to four tags. Each: text, icon_svg, x and y (px in the art box), end (hex colour the tag fades to).

sr_list.description: Full-sentence versions of the tags, read by screen readers. Plain strings.

cta_logo_svg.description: Inline SVG mark at the start of the bar.

head_width.description: Width cap of the heading block in px (live: 560 on Asset Management, 640 on the other solution pages).

lede_width.description: Width cap of the lede paragraph in px (live: 560; the 2026-10 hub frames: 800).
